info.title: Hashtag Web3 static catalogs
info.description: Human website first. Machine-readable data is served as static JSON under /data/ (CDN). No hosted MCP or public REST search API.

200.description: City summaries with slug, country, timezone, estimated monthly USD costs and source reference scores. See /nomad-data-notices.txt for data provenance and attribution.

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: A slug from the city index, such as lisbon.

200.description: City details, cost breakdown, monthly climate, connectivity and community links.

Object with cities (city slugs) and rows. Row fields: id, name, category index, latitude, longitude, city index, website, source quality, rating, review count, address. Categories: 0 coliving, 1 hostel, 2 apartment, 3 guesthouse, 4 coworking. Zero rating/review count means unavailable. Imported directory, not live availability; includes OpenStreetMap contributor data.
Array of passport countries with id, name and ISO code.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: An id from the passport index, such as india.

200.description: Object with passport and destinations (name, iso, rule). Rule t: vf visa-free, voa visa on arrival, ev electronic visa/authorization, vr visa required, fm freedom of movement, na unavailable. Rule d: source stay length in days; zero means unspecified. Short-visit reference snapshot, not authorization to work or reside.
